experiment_title: Token-Efficient RAG: Reducing Context Size and Latency Through Reranking and Contextual Compression
research_question: To what extent can reranking and extractive contextual compression reduce context-token usage and response latency in a local RAG system while maintaining answer quality?

prompt.system_prompt: Answer only from the provided context. Do not use outside knowledge. If the answer is not contained in the context, say exactly: 'I cannot find the answer in the provided documents.' Cite the relevant source chunk IDs in square brackets at the end of each answer.

index.faiss_index_type: IndexFlatIP (exact search, cosine via L2-normalised vectors)

chunking.method: deterministic character windows ending at last whitespace; next window starts overlap chars earlier at a word boundary

optimized.compression_method: extractive: line+regex sentence split of the top-3 reranked chunks, overlap de-duplication, cross-encoder (same reranker model) relevance score per segment, keep segments with logit >= 0.0 (minimum 5 segments), stop before formatted context exceeds 700 tokens; verbatim text, reading order preserved
optimized.compression_parameters_chosen: a priori, before any evaluation run; not tuned on evaluation questions

token_counting.tiktoken_check: tiktoken cannot map gemma-3-4b-it: 'Could not automatically map gemma-3-4b-it to a tokeniser. Please use `tiktoken.get_encoding` to explicitly get the tokeniser you expect.'
token_counting.raw_retrieved_context_tokens: local Gemma tokenizer on formatted retrieved chunks (baseline: top-5; optimized: initial top-10)
token_counting.final_context_tokens: local Gemma tokenizer on the exact context string sent to the LLM
token_counting.input_prompt_tokens: LM Studio usage.prompt_tokens (loaded GGUF tokenizer incl. chat template); local estimate kept separately
token_counting.output_tokens: LM Studio usage.completion_tokens; local estimate kept separately

latency_definitions.retrieval_time_seconds: query embedding + FAISS search + chunk text lookup
latency_definitions.reranking_time_seconds: cross-encoder scoring of initial candidates + sort (0 for baseline)
latency_definitions.compression_time_seconds: segment split + dedup + cross-encoder segment scoring + token-budgeted selection (0 for baseline)
latency_definitions.generation_time_seconds: LM Studio streamed chat completion, request to last token
latency_definitions.ttft_seconds: time to first streamed content token (reflects prompt processing)
latency_definitions.total_latency_seconds: question received -> final answer, incl. prompt construction and any retries
latency_definitions.excluded: model loading, index building, measurement-only token counting

run_order: questions in file order; within each question the pipeline order alternates (even index: baseline first; odd index: optimized first) to balance cache/thermal/order effects
